storageLocation.heading: Default storage location
storageLocation.description: Used the first time a new project is saved.

autoOpenHmi.label: Automatically open the simulation view
autoOpenHmi.description: When entering simulation, automatically switch to the "Simulation HMI" tab if the project has at least one HMI page, otherwise open the 3D scene tab if the project has a scene.

defaultDialect.heading: Default expression language
defaultDialect.description: Applied to new blank projects. The language of an existing project is changed in its properties.
defaultDialect.FR: French: ET, OU, NON, VRAI, FAUX
defaultDialect.EN: English: AND, OR, NOT, TRUE, FALSE

firstProject.title: Your preferences
firstProject.body: Choose the language of your projects' expressions (conditions, actions, equations). You can change it later in Preferences.
